description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

This setting is only applicable if the virtual disk type is VHDX

NOTE:  The default is the sytem default which is the same as "Not Configured"

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\VHDXSectorSize
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = System Default, 512, 4096
